_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.dst: Görev Serisi Başladı: Cüceler ve Dogunlar

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: Rapor, iki türün yer için rekabet edeceğini öne sürüyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: "Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: Bir İnsan'ın Cüce oyunu izlemek istemesi ilginç!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: Sahnelediğimiz tek oyun her yılki Zafer Festivali.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.dst: Bir yere otur ve gösterinin tadını çıkar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.dst: Dur, bu- Hey, {u}! Seni görmek ne güzel!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.dst: Merhaba Gavel halkı, burada bu kadar çok kişiyi görmek sevindirici!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: Umarım oyundan keyif alırsınız ve çok da öğretici olur. Bu akşamın anlatıcısı benim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: Umarım oyundan keyif alırsınız, ve çok da öğretici olur. Bu akşamın anlatıcısı benim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: Sanırım burada, dağlarda güvendeyiz. Aa bak. Parlak madenler. Burası resmen altın madeni.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: Bu güzel mineraller çok güzel, hadi kazmaya başlayalım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: Ben tehlikeli bir canavarım ve bu elmasları kazmanıza izin vermeyeceğim. Biz Dogunlarız ve sizi öldüreceğiz!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: Graoaoro. Öğleden sonraki iblis ziyafetimde hepinizi yiyeceğim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: Karşılık verebilmek için daha iyi silahlar dövmeliyiz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: İyi fikir! Zekâmızı kullanıp iblisleri katledeceğiz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.dst: Ejderhalar bize denk değil mi?? HÜCUM!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: Kazandık. Yaşasın. Ve artık büyük bir kale kurduk: {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: Cüce aklı, iblislerin büyüsünün kaba gücünü yendi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: Umarım gösteriden keyif aldınız ve bugün yeni bir şey öğrendiniz!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: Kutlamaya eski İblis Şehri'nde devam ediyoruz. Oraya gitmek için {p} dışındaki kırmızı sancakları takip edin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: Off, berbattı. Burada gördüğün hiçbir şeye inanma, insan. Tarihi kazananlar yazar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: Herkese hoş geldiniz! Cüce kardeşlerim, misafirler ve ziyaretçiler!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.src: Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.dst: Herkese, hepinize hoş geldiniz! Cüce kardeşlerim, misafirler ve ziyaretçiler!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: Açarken kapak elinde biraz ufalanıyor. Bu ne kadar eski?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: Dikkatinizi kuzeydeki ahşap sahneye çekebilirsem başlayabiliriz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: Alçak iblislere... Dogunlara karşı kazandığımız zaferi kutladığımız yıllık festivale hoş geldiniz!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: Şimdi, şenlik ateşine doğru dönerseniz, biz hazırlanırken hepiniz için güzel bir ateş büyüsü gösterisi hazırladık!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: Vay, Cücelerin böyle bir büyü öğrenebildiğini bilmiyordum! Havai fişeği resmen sollar!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: Muhteşem! Ateş büyücülerimize çok teşekkürler. Şimdi hanımlar beyler, dikkatinizi ana sahneye alalım lütfen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: Son {~} yıldır savaştan kaçan kaçak Dogunları yakaladık, bu yıl da istisna değil!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: Şimdi bu alçak iblisi, sergilenen diğer Dogunların arasına katılması için mühürleyeceğiz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: Büyülü kudretine, saldırgan doğasına, yoğun sıcaklığına ve vahşi görünüşüne dikkat edin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: Hiçbiri Cüce uluslarının dehasına ve dayanışmasına denk değil!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: Her yıl, her yıl, her Allah'ın YILI bunu yapıyorsunuz. Bir kere olsun şu kutsanmış gözlerinizi açın artık!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: Size söylenen her şeye gerçekten inanıyor musunuz? Köpekler gibi yalayıp yutuyor musunuz?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: Savaşı bizim taraf kazandı, ama bu gerçekten haklı olduğumuz anlamına mı geliyor? Hemen söyleyeyim, gelmiyor!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: Hepimiz görüyoruz- Dogunların da buradaki herkes gibi duyguları, aileleri ve düşünceleri var!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: Eğlence için canlı Dogunları mühürlüyorsunuz. Herkesin önünde idam! Bu sapkın gösteri, onların hayal edebileceğinden bile daha şeytani!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: Muhafızlar! Propaganda kusan bu bücürü kuzey taraftaki Molten Core Hapishanesi'ne götürün.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.dst: Gelin bayım. Daha fazla olay çıkarmayalım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: Axelus neden bu kadar apaçık yanlış bir şey söylesin ki?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.dst: Onu gerçekten Molten Core'a mı götürüyorlar? Orası hakkındaki korkunç hikâyeleri duymuşsundur, değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: Eh, 'kuzeyden umut esmez' deyimi oradan çıkmış, kuzey tarafta olduğu için...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: Hepinizden özür dilerim. Buradaki zeminde {p} şehrine hızlı dönüş yolu sağlayacağım. Kesintiye rağmen gösteriden keyif aldığınızı umarız!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: {p} hapishanesindeki çılgına dönmüş cüce hakkında daha fazlasını öğren.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: Görüyorum ki dikkatini çektim. Gerçekle ilgileniyorsun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: Ben komplo kafalı biri değilim. Cücelere yüzlerce yıldır savaş hakkında yalan söyleniyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.dst: Gerçeği gördüm. Ama benim sözüm yetmez, değil mi? Ne de olsa görmek inanmaktır.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: Axelus'un notunu al ve [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumuna git.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: Evet, artık benim okuduğumu sen de okudun. Gerçek... ya da yalan.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: Halkım zalim ve fatih... ama aynı zamanda iyi. Halkın beyni yıkanmış.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: Yakında çok şey olacak. Daha fazlasını öğrenmek istersen {p} içindeki {~} numaralı eve gel. Bekliyor olacağım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.dst: Ah, gelebildin. Gel, Korzim ile tanış
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: Biz... barış... isteyenleriz. Ben... Dogun Şefinin... oğluyum... Sürgün... edildim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: Koalisyon, gerçeğe inanan küçük bir grup. Dogunlar iblis değil, Cücelerin de hepsinin beyni yıkanmış değil.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.dst: Ama tabii saklanarak yaşamak zorundayız. Dogunlar Cücelere tahammül etmez, Cüceler de hainleri ve "İblisleri" avlar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: Ama tabii ki saklanarak yaşamak zorundayız. Dogunlar Cücelere tahammül etmez, Cüceler de hainleri ve "İblisleri" avlar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.src: We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.dst: Uyudukları... yatakları... eritirdik... Ne de olsa... biz... erimiş kayayız.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: Bu sığınağı Dogunlar dakikalar içinde yaptı, bize günler sürerdi!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: Bir kontrol paneli. Nasıl çalıştığını çözmeye çalışmak boşuna, belki kaba kuvvet gerekir.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: Şu anda halkı ikna etmeye çalışıyoruz. Ama imkânsız değilse bile çok zor olduğu ortada.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: {~} yıl öncesi değil artık. Burada barış içinde yaşayacak teknolojimiz ve tedarik zincirimiz var, ama dinlemiyorlar işte!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: Bir... planımız var... Halkımı... kazanmak için... yani.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: Korzim, ejderha kemiğinin halkı için kutsal olduğunu söyledi. Birkaç bağlantı kurmamız gerekti ama artık onu elde etmenin bir yolu var.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.dst: İstersen bizimle gelebilirsin. Durumu sonra daha ayrıntılı anlatırız. Çıkış arkadan.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#092.src: Follow the group on the mission.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: Diğerleri... hemen ileride. Seni... tünelimizden... geçireyim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: Biz.. toprak ve.. ateş.. elementlerini kullanırız. Yavaştır... bizim gibi.. ama güçlüdür.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: Biz... toprak ve... ateş... elementlerini kullanırız. Yavaştır... bizim gibi... ama güçlüdür.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.src: We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.dst: Siz insanların... burada olmasını yasaklamıyoruz, ama lütfen gidin... İstenmeyen... cüceler istemiyoruz burada.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: Bu matkabı ta Corkus'tan getirdik. Axelus almak için servet ödedi, ama bu iş görür!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.dst: AAAAH! Salak Corkus dolandırıcıları! Kahrolsun hepsi! Kaç Zümrüt çöpe gitti?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: Off, makinelerle hiç tecrüben var mı? Belki şu hurda yığınını nasıl tamir edeceğimize dair bir fikrin vardır.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: Onu koalisyon üssüne geri götürebilirsin. Barden'la benim size katılmadan önce toparlanmamız lazım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: Geldiğimiz mağaranın önündeki siyah bloğa vurman yeterli.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: Ejderha kemiği bütün eyaletlerdeki en sert maddelerden biri. Son derece nadir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: Bunu Dogun şefine haraç olarak sunacağız. Biraz toparlamamız lazım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: Üssün doğu tarafından [{~} Repair Kit] getirebilir misin?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: Üssün doğu tarafındaki [Repair Kit] eşyasını getir.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: Bu duvarın arkasından sesler geliyor, iz de burada bitiyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.dst: Burada hiç kasamız yok. Hainler olmalı... Kral Axelus'u görmeyi çok istiyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: Hayır, hayır, tamir setini boş ver! Onu düşünecek vakit yok!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: Yerimiz ortaya çıktı, kapılarımızı paramparça ettiler! Hemen tahliye etmeliyiz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: Daha önce hiç böyle yakalanmamıştık, Dogunların gerçekten bizim tarafımızda olduğunu hiç bilmiyorlardı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: Hemen güvenli bir yere geçmeliyiz! En az keşfedilmiş bölge Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.dst: Herkes dışarı! Hemen! Engebeli arazide peşimizden gelmezler!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.dst: Tünelden Dogun Köyü'ne çıkan yolu bul.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.dst: Biz buralarda kalacağız, köyde hoş karşılanmıyoruz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.dst: Köye girmekte özgürsün ama biz geride kalıp ortalık sakinleşene kadar bekleyeceğiz. Devam et.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.src: What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.dst: Hey, bunlar... Dogun değil mi?! Koca bir yerleşim...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.dst: Güç topluyorlar! {p} şehrine hemen haber vermeliyiz!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.dst: Bizi... yok ederler... Eğer o... {p} şehrine... haber verirse.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.src: We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.dst: Savunmamızı... hazırlamalıyız. Alabileceğimiz... her yardıma ihtiyacımız var.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.src: If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.dst: Bilet istiyorsan bana [{~} Emerald Block] ödemen gerekecek.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.src: ...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.dst: ...aman tanrım, sebebi bu olmalı! D-Dogunlar mı?!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.src: Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.dst: Halk arasında çeşitli söylentilerin yayılması öneriliyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.src: He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.dst: Düşmanla iş birliği yapıyor! Axelus, ruhunu kirletmişler!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.src: They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.dst: Bizi... yok ederler... Eğer o... {p} şehrine... haber verirse.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.src: "Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.dst: "Herhangi bir savaş {p} ve diğer yerleşik kolonilerde isyana yol açabilir."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.dst: Savunmamızı... hazırlamalıyız. Alabileceğimiz... her yardıma ihtiyacımız var.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.src: Wait... What are...you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.dst: Dur... Elindeki... ne? Ejderha kemiği mi...? Tam da ihtiyacımız olan...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.src: Human...if you promise to help us...I will grant you access to...our secret elevators... You can get up and...down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.dst: İnsan... bize yardım edeceğine söz verirsen... sana gizli asansörlerimizi... kullanma izni veririm... Onlarla tepelerde... inip çıkabilirsin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.src: Please return to...us when you reach level {~}. Take this...badge so the...others recognize you...as an ally. One of the elevators is...to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.dst: Lütfen {~}. seviyeye ulaşınca... bize dön. Bu rozeti al ki... diğerleri seni... müttefik olarak tanısın. Asansörlerden biri... güneyde.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#148.src: Ugh, that was horrible.. Like I said before, this war was a genocide. Don't believe any of the lies they try and feed you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#148.dst: Off, berbattı.. Daha önce de dediğim gibi, bu savaş bir soykırımdı. Sana yedirmeye çalıştıkları yalanların hiçbirine inanma.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#148.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#149.src: Make your way to the Dogun festival at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#149.dst: {p} dışındaki kırmızı sancakları takip ederek [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Dogun festivaline git.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#150.src: Looks like Axelus dropped a note...? Doesn't seem like anyone else noticed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#150.dst: Axelus bir not düşürmüş gibi...? Başka kimse fark etmemiş gibi.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#151.src: Seems like Axelus had more to say. Since no one else picked up the note, you may as well seek him out.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#151.dst: Axelus'un söyleyecek daha çok şeyi varmış gibi. Notu başka kimse almadığına göre onu bulmaya gidebilirsin.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#152.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#152.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki {p} hapishanesinde bulunan çılgına dönmüş cüce hakkında daha fazlasını öğren

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#153.src: You came at the right time, {u}. It's good to see you're still interested in what's really going on here..
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#153.dst: Tam zamanında geldin, {u}. Burada gerçekte neler olduğuyla hâlâ ilgilendiğini görmek güzel..
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#153.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#154.src: I've told you this already, but you have to know that it really is true. The Dwarves have been lied to for so long about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#154.dst: Bunu sana zaten söyledim ama gerçekten doğru olduğunu bilmelisin. Cücelere savaş hakkında çok uzun zamandır yalan söyleniyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#154.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#155.src: ..But I think it's best if you see it for yourself. Relying on my word alone won't be enough to grasp the full extent of this dilemma.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#155.dst: ..Ama bence en iyisi kendi gözlerinle görmen. Sadece benim sözüme güvenmek bu açmazın boyutunu kavramana yetmez.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#155.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#156.src: It seems like Axelus slipped another note into your pocket.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#156.dst: Axelus cebine bir not daha sıkıştırmış gibi görünüyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#156.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#157.src: That gate must be the entrance to the Library that Axelus mentioned, but it looks locked tight. Could anything in the area open it up?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#157.dst: Bu kapı Axelus'un bahsettiği Kütüphane'nin girişi olmalı, ama sımsıkı kilitli görünüyor. Etrafta onu açabilecek bir şey var mı?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#158.src: It's an extremely old book. The pages are torn, yellowed, and dusty.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#158.dst: Çok eski bir kitap. Sayfaları yırtık, sararmış ve tozlu.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#159.src: "Top Secret"? The words are faded and hard to make out.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#159.dst: "Çok Gizli" mi? Yazılar solmuş, zor okunuyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#160.src: It seems to be a report written at the start of the Dogun war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#160.dst: Dogun savaşının başında yazılmış bir rapora benziyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#161.src: "The natives occupy {~} of the habitable land in the heights..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#161.dst: "Yerliler tepelerdeki yaşanabilir arazinin {~} kadarını işgal ediyor..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#162.src: Several pages are dedicated to the Doguns personalities, traits and powers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#162.dst: Birkaç sayfa Dogunların kişiliklerine, özelliklerine ve güçlerine ayrılmış.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#165.src: "Clearance is needed if Dwarves are going to form a colony..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#165.dst: "Cüceler bir koloni kuracaksa arazinin temizlenmesi gerekiyor..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#166.src: According to the report, the land was once rich with minerals and materials.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#166.dst: Rapora göre bu topraklar bir zamanlar mineral ve malzeme bakımından zenginmiş.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#167.src: This page appears to have been ripped out and crudely reattached.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#167.dst: Bu sayfa koparılıp kabaca yeniden takılmış gibi görünüyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#168.src: "A program of public profiling of the natives is recommended..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#168.dst: "Yerlilerin halka yönelik bir profilleme programı öneriliyor..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#169.src: There are detailed instructions on producing propaganda against the Doguns.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#169.dst: Dogunlara karşı propaganda üretmek için ayrıntılı talimatlar var.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#170.src: "...recommend they are referred to as demons, as inherent fear will take hold..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#170.dst: "...onlardan iblis diye söz edilmesi önerilir, böylece içgüdüsel korku yerleşecektir..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#171.src: The report details propaganda at all levels of society, particularly at educational centers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#171.dst: Rapor, toplumun her kesiminde, özellikle eğitim merkezlerinde yapılacak propagandayı ayrıntılandırıyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#172.src: "Once public opinion is sufficiently hostile, establishment of colonies will be achievable..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#172.dst: "Kamuoyu yeterince düşmanca hâle geldiğinde kolonilerin kurulması mümkün olacaktır..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#173.src: The report goes on to detail the total dominance of {p} and the importance of propaganda continuation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#173.dst: Rapor devamında {p} şehrinin tam hâkimiyetini ve propagandanın sürdürülmesinin önemini ayrıntılandırıyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#174.src: Now do you see? Everything that I told you about when we rescued those flerisi was indeed true...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#174.dst: Şimdi görüyor musun? O flerisi'leri kurtardığımızda sana anlattığım her şey gerçekten doğruymuş...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#174.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#175.src: Search for house number {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#175.dst: Axelus'un dediği gibi {p} içindeki {~} numaralı evi ara.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#179.src: To repair the mechanical core, select a colour and connect the clay with the same coloured glass block by clicking the iron blocks with the Rewiring Tool.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#179.dst: Mekanik çekirdeği onarmak için bir renk seç ve Rewiring Tool ile demir bloklara tıklayarak kili aynı renkteki cam blokla bağla.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#180.src: Head back to the coalition through the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#181.src: The king has sent for you personally.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#181.speaker: Pens'r

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#182.src: If you don't come with us we wi-
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#182.speaker: Pens'r

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#183.src: Entomb these Doguns, and slay their Dwarven thralls!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#183.dst: Bu Dogunları mühürleyin, Cüce kölelerini de katledin!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#183.speaker: Pens'r

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#184.src: But...bring them...the dragon bone...as a gift. If they accept it...they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#184.dst: Ama... onlara... ejderha kemiğini... hediye olarak götür. Kabul ederlerse... belki bizi de kabul ederler.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#184.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#185.src: We need to solve...this conflict somehow. Please...help us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#185.dst: Bu çatışmayı... bir şekilde çözmeliyiz. Lütfen... bize yardım et.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#185.speaker: Korzim
